or: Deus, qui beáti Mártyris tui Francísci fidem mirábili constántia roborásti: concéde propítius Ecclésiæ tuæ ut ejus précibus adjúta; novos ubíque fídei triúmphos celebráre mereátur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who strengthened the faith of blessed Francis, Your martyr, with wonderful constancy; mercifully grant that Your Church, helped by his prayers, may deserve to celebrate new triumphs of the faith everywhere; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Deus, qui veræ caritátis offíciis beátum Francíscum ad hanc salutárem Hóstiam offeréndam se dispónere docuísti: præsta, quǽsumus, ut pari caritátis ardóre ad sacra mystéria accedéntes, eórum fructum copiósius percipiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the works of true charity taught blessed Francis to prepare himself for offering this saving Victim; grant, we beseech You, that approaching the sacred mysteries with like ardor of charity, we may receive their fruit more abundantly; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Deus, qui beátum Francíscum, sacra mystéria celebrántem, supérnis delíciis afflúere voluísti: ipsíus nobis intervéntu concéde ut Angelórum pane refécti terréna despícere; et advérsa ómnia fórtiter superáre discámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that blessed Francis, while celebrating the sacred mysteries, should overflow with heavenly delights; grant us through his intercession that, refreshed with the bread of Angels, we may learn to despise the things of earth and bravely to overcome all adversities; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Adésto Dómine supplicatiónibus nostris: ut qui ex iniquitáte nostra reos nos esse cognóscimus; beáti Vincéntii Mártyris tui intercessióne liberémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Be present, O Lord, to our supplications, that we who know ourselves to be guilty by our iniquity may be delivered by the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Munéribus nostris, quǽsumus Dómine, precibúsque suscéptis: intercedénte beáto Vincéntio Mártyre tuo, et cæléstibus nos munda mystériis, et cleménter exáudi. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received our gifts and prayers, O Lord, we beseech You, through the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr, both cleanse us by the heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Vincéntio Mártyre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

S0410b.page: 410; Secret and Postcommunion from the Commune, p. 9*
or: Deus, qui beátum Antónium, ad lucem veritátis tuæ misericórditer revocátum, exímium Mártyrem effecísti: præsta, ut ejus intercessióne simus semper in fide stábiles; et in ópere efficáces: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Anthony, mercifully called back to the light of Your truth, an outstanding martyr; grant that through his intercession we may ever be steadfast in faith and effective in deed; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Munéribus nostris, quǽsumus Dómine, precibúsque suscéptis: intercedénte beáto António Mártyre tuo, et cæléstibus nos munda mystériis, et cleménter exáudi. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received our gifts and prayers, O Lord, we beseech You, through the intercession of blessed Anthony, Your martyr, both cleanse us by the heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto António Mártyre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Anthony, Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Innova, Dómine, in córdibus nostris amórem tuæ Crucis; ut intercessióne et exémplo beátæ Hosánnæ Vírginis pœniténtis, dolórum tuórum partícipes efficiámur et glóriæ. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Renew in our hearts, O Lord, the love of Your Cross, that by the intercession and example of blessed Osanna, Your penitent virgin, we may be made sharers in Your sufferings and in Your glory; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, Dómine, hæc dona quæ in beátæ Hosánnæ Vírginis commemoratióne deférimus, et præsta ut, ea intercedénte, castitátis et pœniténtiæ donis tibi júgiter placére valeámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O Lord, these gifts which we offer in commemoration of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, and grant that through her intercession we may ever be able to please You by the gifts of chastity and penance; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Deus, qui de uno pane et de uno cálice participántes unum in Christo corpus nos esse voluísti: per beátæ Hosánnæ Vírginis intercessiónem fidéles tuos in veritáte confírma; et a recta fide aberrántes ad Ecclésiæ tuæ révoca unitátem. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that we who partake of one bread and one chalice should be one body in Christ; through the intercession of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, confirm Your faithful in the truth, and call back to the unity of Your Church those who have strayed from the right faith; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Da, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Dámasi Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis veneránda solémnitas; et devotiónem nobis áugeat, et salútem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Damasus, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Sancti tui, quǽsumus Dómine, nos ubíque lætíficent: ut dum eórum mérita recólimus, patrocínia sentiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we recall their merits we may feel their patronage; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Præsta, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut de percéptis munéribus grátias exhibéntes; intercedénte beáto Dámaso Confessóre tuo atque Pontífice, benefícia potióra sumámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts we have received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Damasus, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Leónem minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave to Your people blessed Leo as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Leónis Confessóris tui atque Doctóris, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Leo, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Leónis Confessóris tui atque Doctóris nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Leo, Your confessor and doctor, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Exáudi nos Deus salutáris noster: ut sicut de beátæ Hosánnæ Vírginis tuæ festivitáte gaudémus; ita piæ devotiónis erudiámur afféctu: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, so we may be taught the affection of loving devotion; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Supplicatiónem servórum tuórum Deus miserátor exáudi: ut qui in solemnitáte Dei Genitrícis et Vírginis congregámur; ejus intercessiónibus a te de instántibus perículis eruámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Mercifully hear, O God, the supplication of Your servants, that we who are gathered together on the feast of the Mother of God and Virgin may by her intercession be delivered by You from the dangers that threaten us; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Unigéniti tui, Dómine, nobis succúrrat humánitas: ut qui natus de Vírgine, Matris integritátem non mínuit, sed sacrávit, in solemnitáte ejus, nostris nos piáculis éxuens, oblatiónem nostram tibi fáciat accéptam: Jesus Christus Dóminus noster, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Súmpsimus, Dómine, celebritátis ánnuæ votíva sacraménta; præsta quǽsumus, ut et temporális vitæ nobis remédia prǽbeant, et ætérnæ: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Concéde nobis, quǽsumus, Dómine: ut, qui solemnitátem beátæ Maríæ Vírginis Regínæ nostræ celebrámus; ejus muníti præsídio, pacem in præsénti et glóriam in futúro cónsequi mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, that we who celebrate the feast of the blessed Virgin Mary, our Queen, may, defended by her protection, deserve to obtain peace in this life and glory in the life to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accipe, quǽsumus, Dómine, múnera lætántis Ecclésiæ: et, beátæ Vírginis Maríæ Regínæ suffragántibus méritis, ad nostræ salútis auxílium proveníre concéde. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Accept, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts of Your rejoicing Church, and grant that, through the pleading merits of the blessed Virgin Mary, Queen, they may avail for the help of our salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Celebrátis solémniis, Dómine, quæ pro sanctæ Maríæ, Regínæ nostræ, festivitáte perégimus: ejus, quǽsumus, nobis intercessióne fiant salutária; in cujus honóre sunt exsultánter impléta: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having celebrated the solemnities which we have performed for the feast of holy Mary, our Queen, we beseech You, O Lord, that through her intercession they may become salutary for us, in whose honor they have been joyfully fulfilled; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátos Mártyres tuos Petrum Pontíficem ejúsque sócios ad fidem géntibus prædicándam pari firmitáte et caritáte donásti: præsta, quǽsumus; eórum exémplo et intercessióne nos in tua fide permanére constántes. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who endowed Your blessed martyrs Peter, bishop, and his companions with equal firmness and charity for preaching the faith to the nations; grant, we beseech You, that by their example and intercession we may remain constant in Your faith; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, Dómine, propítius preces nostras cum oblatiónibus hostiárum, et tuórum deprecatióne Mártyrum Petri Pontíficis ac sociórum ejus, pietáti tuæ pérfice benígnus accéptas. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Graciously receive, O Lord, our prayers with the offerings of victims, and through the pleading of Your martyrs Peter, bishop, and his companions, kindly make them acceptable to Your loving kindness; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, qui in sanctórum córdibus flammam tuæ dilectiónis accéndis: da nobis, per sacraménta quæ súmpsimus, eámdem fidem, caritatísque virtútem; et quorum gaudémus triúmphis, proficiámus exémplis. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and merciful God, who kindle in the hearts of the saints the flame of Your love; grant us, through the sacraments we have received, the same faith and strength of charity, that we may profit by the example of those in whose triumphs we rejoice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Mártyrum tuórum nos, Dómine, Joséphi, Melchióris et sociórum conféssio beáta commúniat; et fragilitáti nostræ subsídium dignánter exóret: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the blessed confession of Your martyrs Joseph, Melchior and their companions fortify us, O Lord, and graciously obtain help for our frailty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Benedíctio tua, Dómine, larga descéndat: quæ et múnera nostra, deprecántibus sanctis Martýribus tuis, tibi reddat accépta, et nobis sacraméntum redemptiónis effíciat. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your blessing, O Lord, descend abundantly, to make our gifts acceptable to You through the prayers of Your holy martyrs, and to make them for us the sacrament of redemption; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Cæléstibus refécti sacraméntis et gáudiis, súpplices te, Dómine, deprecámur: ut, quorum gloriámur triúmphis; protegámur auxíliis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed by the heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly entreat You, O Lord, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

S0731.page: 510; Secret and Postcommunion from the Commune Confessoris non Pontificis
or: Deus, qui ad majórem tui nóminis glóriam propagándam, novo per beátum Ignátium subsídio militántem Ecclésiam roborásti: concéde, ut ejus auxílio et imitatióne certántes in terris; coronári cum ipso mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who for the spreading of the greater glory of Your name strengthened the Church militant with a new help through blessed Ignatius; grant that, striving on earth by his help and example, we may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Ignátio Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Veneránda nobis, Dómine, hujus diéi festívitas opem cónferat salutárem; in qua sancta Dei Génitrix mortem súbiit temporálem: nec tamen mortis néxibus déprimi pótuit; quæ Fílium tuum Dóminum nostrum de se génuit incarnátum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the venerable festival of this day, O Lord, bring us saving help, on which the holy Mother of God underwent temporal death, yet could not be held down by the bonds of death, she who brought forth of herself Your Son, our Lord, made flesh; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Subvéniat, Dómine, plebi tuæ Dei Genitrícis orátio: quam etsi pro conditióne carnis migrásse cognóscimus, in cælésti glória apud te pro nobis intercédere sentiámus. Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the prayer of the Mother of God, O Lord, come to the aid of Your people; that we who know that she has departed this life according to the condition of the flesh may feel that she intercedes for us with You in heavenly glory; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Mensæ cæléstis partícipes effécti, implorámus cleméntiam tuam Dómine Deus noster: ut qui Assumptiónem Dei Genitrícis cólimus; a cunctis malis imminéntibus, ejus intercessióne liberémur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Made partakers of the heavenly table, we implore Your mercy, O Lord our God, that we who keep the Assumption of the Mother of God may by her intercession be delivered from all evils that threaten us; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Francíscum Confessórem tuum, supérnæ caritátis dulcédine perfúsum, verbi tui præcónem exímium effecísti: ejus intercessióne concéde; ut igne tui amóris incénsi, in tua dilectióne semper vivámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Francis, Your confessor, steeped in the sweetness of heavenly charity, an outstanding herald of Your word; grant through his intercession that, kindled with the fire of Your love, we may ever live in Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Da, quǽsumus Dómine, ut sicut beátus Francíscus juge se tibi sacrifícium ófferens, spíritum suum ad æternitátem áluit: grátiæ tuæ nobis semper concíliet ubertátem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that as blessed Francis, ever offering himself to You as a sacrifice, nourished his spirit for eternity, so he may ever win for us the abundance of Your grace; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacris refécti aliméntis, te súpplices deprecámur, omnípotens Deus: ut intercedénte beáto Francísco, quem, post oblátum tibi sacrifícium, ad salútis portum pretiósa morte transíre fecísti; nos étiam, in vitæ éxitu cælésti pábulo roborátos, ejúsdem glóriæ fácias esse consórtes: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with sacred food, we humbly entreat You, almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Francis, whom after offering You the sacrifice You caused to pass by a precious death to the haven of salvation, You would make us also, strengthened at the end of life with heavenly food, sharers of the same glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Ambrósium minístrum tribuísti: præsta quǽsumus, ut quem doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris; intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gave to Your people blessed Ambrose as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, múnera tuæ majestáti obláta, per intercessiónem beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis, ad perpétuam nobis fac proveníre salútem. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sacraménta salútis nostræ suscipiéntes, concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Ambrósii Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis nos ubíque orátio ádjuvet; in cujus veneratióne hæc tuæ obtúlimus majestáti: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor and bishop, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Lauréntium Confessórem tuum reguláris disciplínæ stúdio, et caritátis ardóre claréscere fecísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde; ut perfectióra semper exsequéntes, ætérna gáudia consequámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Laurence, Your confessor, illustrious by zeal for regular discipline and by the ardor of charity; grant us through his intercession that, ever striving after what is more perfect, we may attain eternal joys; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe Dómine oblatiónem, quam tibi offérimus: et beáti Lauréntii méritis atque imitatióne, spirituálium donórum augménta capiámus. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O Lord, the offering which we make to You, and by the merits and imitation of blessed Laurence may we receive an increase of spiritual gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti, Dómine, munéribus sacris, te humíliter deprecámur: ut mundi illécebras fastidiéntes; beáto Lauréntio Confessóre tuo intercedénte, cæléstes delícias júgiter appetámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed, O Lord, with sacred gifts, we humbly entreat You that, despising the allurements of the world, we may, through the intercession of blessed Laurence, Your confessor, ever long for heavenly delights; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

S0222.page: 356-358 (Cathedra S. Petri Romæ, as the Missal directs)
or: Deus, qui beáto Petro Apóstolo tuo, collátis clávibus regni cæléstis, ligándi atque solvéndi pontifícium tradidísti: concéde, ut intercessiónis ejus auxílio; a peccatórum nostrórum néxibus liberémur: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who, giving to blessed Peter, Your apostle, the keys of the heavenly kingdom, bestowed on him the high-priestly power of binding and loosing; grant that by the help of his intercession we may be delivered from the bonds of our sins; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Ecclésiæ tuæ, quǽsumus Dómine, preces et hóstias beáti Petri Apóstoli tui comméndet orátio: ut quod pro illíus glória celebrámus, nobis prosit ad véniam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the prayer of blessed Peter, Your apostle, we beseech You, O Lord, commend the prayers and offerings of Your Church, that what we celebrate for his glory may avail us for pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Lætíficet nos, Dómine quǽsumus, munus oblátum: ut sicut in Apóstolo tuo Petro te mirábilem prædicámus; sic per illum tuæ sumámus indulgéntiæ largitátem: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the gift offered, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that as we proclaim You wonderful in Your apostle Peter, so through him we may receive the bounty of Your pardon; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

S0524.page: 64*-66* (Missa votiva de S. Dominico, Feria iij, as the Missal directs)
or: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, illumináre dignátus es méritis et doctrínis: concéde, ut ejus intercessióne, temporálibus non destituátur auxíliis; et spirituálibus semper profíciat increméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who were pleased to enlighten Your Church by the merits and teaching of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; grant that through his intercession she may not be deprived of temporal help, and may ever grow in spiritual increase; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera tibi Dómine dicáta sanctífica: ut méritis beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, nobis profíciant ad medélam. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You; that by the merits of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father, they may avail us for healing; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Concéde, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui peccatórum nostrórum póndere prémimur; beáti Domínici Confessóris tui, Patris nostri, patrocínio sublevémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by the patronage of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Henrícum Confessórem tuum córporis mortificatióne, et caritáte mirábilem effecísti: concéde, ut Christum crucifíxum ópere in nobis exprímere; et corde dilígere valeámus: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Henry, Your confessor, wonderful in the mortification of the body and in charity; grant that we may be able to express Christ crucified in our works and to love Him with our heart; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Dómine Jesu Christe, qui hæc sacra in tui commemoratiónem fíeri præcepísti: præsta, ut beáti Henríci imitatióne, te júgiter cogitémus, atque sapiámus. Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O Lord Jesus Christ, who commanded that these sacred rites be done in remembrance of You; grant that, by imitating blessed Henry, we may think of You continually and savor You; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Divínæ sapiéntiæ mensa refécti, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut per sacraménta quæ súmpsimus; beáto Henríco intercedénte, ad vitam ætérnam enutriámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed at the table of divine wisdom, we beseech You, almighty God, that through the sacraments we have received, blessed Henry interceding, we may be nourished unto everlasting life; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui nos ánnua Apostolórum tuórum Philíppi et Jacóbi solemnitáte lætíficas: præsta quǽsumus, ut quorum gaudémus méritis; instruámur exémplis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your Apostles Philip and James; grant, we beseech You, that we may be taught by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera, Dómine, quæ pro Apostolórum tuórum Philíppi et Jacóbi solemnitáte deférimus, propítius súscipe, et mala ómnia, quæ merémur, avérte. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Mercifully receive, O Lord, the gifts which we bring on the feast of Your Apostles Philip and James, and turn away from us all the evils we deserve; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus Dómine, salutáribus repléti mystériis: ut quorum solémnia celebrámus: eórum oratiónibus adjuvémur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Filled with the saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Constántium Confessórem tuum assíduæ oratiónis, et promovéndæ pacis stúdio, in pópulis gloriósum effecísti: ejus nobis intercessióne concéde; ut per justítiæ sémitas incedéntes, pacem et glóriam assequámur ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Constantius, Your confessor, glorious among the peoples by his zeal for constant prayer and for the furthering of peace; grant us by his intercession that, walking in the paths of justice, we may attain to everlasting peace and glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Domínicæ mensæ nobis tribuátur accúmbere in veste caritátis, qua beátus Constántius indútus, ad superióra invitántem audíre méruit Jesum Christum Dóminum nostrum: Qui vivit et regnat cum Deo Patre in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May it be granted us to sit at the table of the Lord in the wedding garment of charity, clothed in which blessed Constantius was found worthy to hear Jesus Christ our Lord inviting him to the higher place; who lives and reigns with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Angelórum pane refécti te deprecámur omnípotens Deus: ut beáti Constántii intercedéntibus méritis; ætérnas tibi laudes persólvere cum ipso valeámus in cælis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with the bread of Angels, we pray You, almighty God, that by the merits and intercession of blessed Constantius we may be able to render You eternal praise with him in heaven; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beáti Petri Confessóris tui précibus et hortaméntis errántes in viam justítiæ misericórditer redíre fecísti: diláta, quǽsumus, illíus intercessióne corda nostra; ut sémitam mandatórum tuórum semper currámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who by the prayers and exhortations of blessed Peter, Your confessor, mercifully brought back the erring into the way of justice; enlarge our hearts, we beseech You, by his intercession, that we may ever run the way of Your commandments; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Petro Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui in húmili vitæ génere beátum Albértum Confessórem tuum exímia sanctitáte claréscere voluísti: fac nos ita ejus sectári vestígia; ut ássequi mereámur et prǽmia: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who willed that blessed Albert, Your confessor, should shine with exceptional holiness in a humble state of life; make us so to follow in his footsteps that we may deserve to attain also his reward; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Laudis tibi Dómine hóstias immolámus in tuórum commemoratióne Sanctórum: quibus nos et præséntibus éxui malis confídimus, et futúris. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Refécti cibo potúque cælésti, Deus noster, te súpplices exorámus: ut in cujus hæc commemoratióne percépimus; ejus muniámur et précibus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátæ Æmíliæ Vírgini tuæ terréna cuncta despícere, et te solum quǽrere tribuísti: ejus méritis et intercessióne concéde; ut sprétis peritúris illécebris, te toto corde diligámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who granted to blessed Emily, Your virgin, to despise all earthly things and to seek You alone; grant by her merits and intercession that, spurning perishable allurements, we may love You with our whole heart; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Accépta tibi sit, Dómine, sacrátæ plebis oblátio pro tuórum honóre Sanctórum, quorum se méritis de tribulatióne percepísse cognóscit auxílium. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Satiásti Dómine famíliam tuam munéribus sacris: ejus, quǽsumus, semper interventióne nos réfove; cujus solémnia celebrámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Excita Dómine in córdibus nostris crucis et passiónis amórem: ut beáti Matthǽi intercessióne et exémplo; dolórum Christi partícipes efficiámur, et glóriæ: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Stir up, O Lord, in our hearts the love of the cross and passion, that through the intercession and example of blessed Matthew we may be made partakers of the sufferings of Christ and of His glory; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Præsta nobis, quǽsumus omnípotens Deus, ut nostræ humilitátis oblátio, et pro tuórum tibi grata sit honóre Sanctórum, et nos córpore páriter et mente puríficet: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut qui cæléstia aliménta percépimus; intercedénte beáto Matthǽo Confessóre tuo, per hæc contra ómnia advérsa muniámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Matthew, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui in beáto Domínico Confessóre tuo munus apostólicum assíduo oratiónis stúdio et reguláris disciplínæ observántia mirabíliter fecundásti: concéde propítius, ut ejus vestígia prosequéntes; úberes salútis fructus percípere mereámur: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who in blessed Dominic, Your confessor, wonderfully made fruitful his apostolic office through constant zeal for prayer and the observance of regular discipline; mercifully grant that, following in his footsteps, we may deserve to gather abundant fruits of salvation; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Súscipe, Deus, hanc Hóstiam immaculátam, ac suffragánte Servo tuo Domínico, da quǽsumus, ut casto córpore ac devóta mente nosmetípsos offeréntes, digno servítio munus perficiámus Fílii tui Dómini nostri Jesu Christi, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Receive, O God, this spotless Victim, and, Your servant Dominic pleading for us, grant, we beseech You, that offering ourselves with chaste body and devout mind, we may fulfil with worthy service the offering of Your Son our Lord Jesus Christ; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Grátia tua sanctíficans, quǽsumus Dómine, nos dóciles effíciat: ut Beáti Domínici intercessióne, strénue coram te ambulántes; in tuo semper amóre crescámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May Your sanctifying grace, we beseech You, O Lord, make us docile, that by the intercession of blessed Dominic, walking earnestly before You, we may ever grow in Your love; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátam Margarítam a sǽculi pompa ad húmilem tuæ crucis sequélam toto corde transíre docuísti: concéde, ut ejus méritis et exémplo, discámus peritúras mundi calcáre delícias; et in ampléxu tuæ crucis ómnia nobis adversántia superáre: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who taught blessed Margaret to pass with her whole heart from the pomp of the world to the humble following of Your cross; grant that by her merits and example we may learn to tread underfoot the perishing delights of the world and, in the embrace of Your cross, to overcome all that opposes us; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Múnera, Dómine, nostræ devotiónis offérimus: ut tibi grata, et nobis salutária, beátæ Margarítæ pia supplicatióne reddántur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may become pleasing to You and salutary to us through the devout supplication of blessed Margaret; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Quǽsumus omnípotens Deus: ut quos salutáribus dignátus es erudíre mystériis; beátæ Margarítæ intercessióne gloriósa, cæléstibus refícias aliméntis: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

We beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You have deigned to instruct by the saving mysteries You may refresh with heavenly food through the glorious intercession of blessed Margaret; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, qui beátum Jordánum Confessórem tuum, evangélicæ prædicatiónis dignum minístrum effecísti: ex ejus nobis imitatióne tríbue operári quæ præcipis; ut ætérnæ mercédis fructum cónsequi valeámus: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, who made blessed Jordan, Your confessor, a worthy minister of the preaching of the Gospel; grant us by his example to do what You command, that we may be able to obtain the fruit of eternal reward; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Per hanc immaculátam hóstiam placábilis sit pro nobis beáti Jordáni intercéssio: ut a cunctis perículis liberáti in témpore, æternitátis glóriæ partícipes esse mereámur. Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Through this spotless Victim may the intercession of blessed Jordan be pleasing for us, that, freed from all dangers in time, we may deserve to be partakers of the glory of eternity; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sumptis munéribus sacris, implorámus Dómine cleméntiam tuam: ut intercedénte beáto Jordáno Confessóre tuo, inter próspera præséntis vitæ, et advérsa sic transeámus; ut glóriam assequámur ætérnam: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Having received the sacred gifts, we implore Your mercy, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Jordan, Your confessor, we may so pass through the prosperity and adversity of this present life that we may attain everlasting glory; through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

or: Deus, cujus Unigénitus per vitam, mortem, et resurrectiónem suam nobis salútis ætérnæ prǽmia comparávit: concéde quǽsumus ut hæc mystéria sanctíssimo Rosário beátæ Maríæ Vírginis recoléntes, et imitémur quod cóntinent; et quod promíttunt assequámur: Per eúndem Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum Fílium tuum, qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

O God, whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death, and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that, meditating upon these mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may both imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise; through the same Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
se: Fac nos, quǽsumus Dómine, his munéribus offeréndis conveniénter aptári: et per sanctíssimi Rosárii mystéria, sic vitam, passiónem, et glóriam Unigéniti tui recólere, ut ejus digni promissiónibus efficiámur. Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti Deus per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

Make us, we beseech You, O Lord, fitly prepared to offer these gifts, and through the mysteries of the most holy Rosary so to recall the life, passion, and glory of Your only-begotten Son that we may be made worthy of His promises; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
pc: Sanctíssimæ Genitrícis tuæ, cujus Rosárium celebrámus; quǽsumus Dómine, précibus adjuvémur: ut et mysteriórum, quæ cólimus, virtus percipiátur; et sacramentórum, quæ súmpsimus, obtineátur efféctus: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.

May we be helped, we beseech You, O Lord, by the prayers of Your most holy Mother, whose Rosary we celebrate, that we may receive the power of the mysteries which we honor and obtain the effect of the sacraments which we have received; who live and reign with God the Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
